regulation_clause.text: For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 5(iv)(b) requires more than 10 percent of capital or profits. T6BO04 (byte-identical code) still has no profit-share field or check at all -- only capital interest is tested (line 17) -- so the profits leg remains unimplemented; the implemented capital leg is additionally still thresholded at 15, not 10.
